ENVO GC20 Electric Buggy Go-Kart | Compact Recreational Off-Road EV
The ENVO GC20 is a compact electric buggy go-kart created for recreation, resorts, campgrounds, private properties, tourism destinations, controlled trails, events, and specialty leisure fleets. Its small footprint, quiet electric drive, responsive handling, and adaptable layout make it a cleaner, lower-maintenance alternative to conventional fuel-powered recreational vehicles. The GC20 can be configured for casual cruising, guided experiences, rental fleets, family recreation, promotional activations, or controlled off-road use.
Accessories shown may be optional, not included in the base price, or unavailable for individual sale. Check the product configuration or contact us for details.
